dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Whenever I'm reading a story, I like to picture it vividly in my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: In the theater of my imagination, the scene plays out in full color. I can see the expressions on the characters' faces, hear their words, feel the cadence of their speech... Text on the page is transformed into a spellbinding show, and I watch with bated breath to see where each person's story will take them.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: So, you see? I'm not just another celebrity. I've got solid directing chops, too!
